scope: bounded paired continuation of completed development checkpoints; no restart, no independent final test
source: completed default SE_GAIN_DEVELOPMENT_PLAN_V1 experiment; seeds2081/2082, gain2 last_checkpoint at epoch100 step5300
source_selection: exactly one completed matching folder unless explicit --source; never guess among multiple runs
training_data: same1680 selected training examples, same1080 reused validation examples; verify source protocol, hashes, grouped selection and disjointness
pair_controls: same source weights, full Adam moments/step state, batch-generator state and input ordering; only lr differs
source_integrity: check all source artifact hashes, checkpoint graph metadata, optimizer settings/steps, batch-generator state and reproduce epoch100 validation matrix/loss before updates
restart_semantics: new optimizer object must load the entire saved Adam state; no reset of moments or generator; numerical interrupted/uninterrupted unit test required
checkpoint_selection: minimum validation cross entropy among starting epoch100 and continuation101..150; ties retain earliest. Earlier source best checkpoints stay untouched but are not branch candidates
primary: paired selected-checkpoint validation loss and macro-F1, separately per seed
secondary: mean absolute per-class recall change over last20 transitions
decision: lower-lr directional advantage only if selected loss is strictly smaller AND macro-F1 strictly higher in both seeds. Lower volatility alone is not improved recognition. Preserve negative/mixed results; do not add epochs or replace seeds automatically
stopping: fixed50 additional epochs; no early stopping, scheduler, clipping, augmentation or automatic further training
report: single root report with all branch endpoints, selected checkpoints, class/SNR metrics, trajectory summaries and source validation checks; no routine manual history uploads needed
limits: validation reused for model selection and prior development; not an independent test
original test already inspected earlier and not opened here
same generators; not real RF or drone protocol performance
one controlled optimizer intervention, no architecture search
backup: source files never overwritten; new output folder and atomic per-epoch checkpoints; completed cases remain reviewable after interruption
